hmong: Peb mus nuam yaj thaum so.

english: He straps the bag onto his back.

hmong: Lawv puab lub lauj kaub av.
Hmo no qaim hli zoo nkauj heev.

english: My father burns firewood for cooking.

hmong: Nws xav rais ua kws kho mob.
english: She wants to become a doctor.

hmong: Cov neeg hu nkauj nyob saum samthiaj.
english: The singers are on the stage.

hmong: Lawv sawblawj cov khoom hauv tsev.
english: They took everything in the house.

hmong: Tsis txhob tabkaum kuv thaum kuv kawm.
english: Do not bother me while I study.

hmong: Kuv xawb lub hnab nrhiav tus yuam sij.
english: I search through the bag for the key.

hmong: Nws zes kuv thaum kuv ua haujlwm.
english: He bothers me while I work.
